jobs.title: Senior Credit Forecasting Analyst
jobs.description_text: As we recently integrated with Barclays, our initial focus is on candidates who are local to the Philadelphia, Delaware, New Jersey, and New York areas. Additionally, beginning in June 2027, employees who live within a 50-mile radius of the office will be expected to work on-site three days per week as part of our hybrid work model. This role owns forcasting, processes, models, and assumptions used to estimate expected credit losses for credit strategy calibration, capital and reporting purposes. You will partner closely with Credit Strategy, Capital Markets, and Data teams to ensure forecasts are accurate, explainable, and aligned with business expectations.

jobs.title: Robot Operator/Technician (Hammond, LA)
jobs.description_text: Ambi Robotics is excited to add a temporary part-time Robot Operator/Technician to the team. We are looking for an individual who will be responsible for operating our AmbiStack systems at a critical customer site during a six-month evaluation period. This role serves the customer as the primary point of contact for field issues with robotic equipment, supports system installations, coordinates with remote engineers for debugging and improvements, operates forklifts safely and efficiently, and collaborates with the Ambi Engineering team to enhance the product. The ideal candidate is customer-obsessed, and goes above and beyond to exceed expectations. Installation begins 11/10/25 and project is expected to be completed 06/30/2026.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist - ADA/PK/Biomarkers
jobs.description_text: Associate Scientists bring established laboratory experience and sound scientific judgment to study execution. In this role, you will perform assay work across development, validation, transfer, qualification, and sample analysis; organize and document scientific data; and address routine technical and operational issues. You will take ownership of assigned work while collaborating with Scientists, Senior Scientists, and project partners to keep studies accurate, compliant, and on schedule. Based on your experience, technical strengths, and the needs of the hiring team, your assignments may focus on sample analysis, assay development, method transfer or qualification, or a combination of laboratory projects.

jobs.title: Project Manager / Senior Project Manager
jobs.description_text: BioAgilytix is growing our Project Management team, and we have multiple openings across the Project Manager and Senior Project Manager levels within Operations. These roles are central to the successful delivery of our client programs, serving as a key connection point between our clients and internal scientific and operational teams. You will partner closely with stakeholders across Operations, Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Sample Management, Finance, Proposals, and other functions to keep programs aligned, risks visible, and deliverables moving forward. We are hiring at both the Project Manager and Senior Project Manager levels, with level determined based on experience, demonstrated project ownership, and the complexity of programs a candidate is prepared to lead. At the Project Manager level, the focus is on coordinating stakeholders and successfully managing intermediate-level projects or project segments. At the Senior Project Manager level, the role expands to independent, end-to-end ownership of higher-complexity programs, multiple concurrent projects, and more proactive client, risk, and escalation management.

jobs.title: Project Setup Lead
jobs.description_text: The Project Setup Lead is responsible for the accurate and timely setup of customer projects, contracts, and related system records to support project execution, revenue forecasting, and billing readiness. This role serves as the primary owner of the project setup process, ensuring customer contracts, proposals, purchase orders, and supporting documentation are reviewed, interpreted, and translated into accurate project records within enterprise systems. The Project Setup Lead partners closely with Revenue, Accounts Receivable, Project Management, Business Development, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to resolve exceptions, improve processes, maintain documentation, and drive operational excellence. This position is highly detail-oriented and requires strong organizational skills, contract review capabilities, process improvement experience, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment. Essential Responsibilities Serve as primary owner of project setup activities, ensuring projects are established accurately and timely within NetSuite and other applicable systems. Review contracts, statements of work, proposals, purchase orders, and other commercial documents to establish project and billing requirements. Review contractual terms to identify project setup and billing requirements and identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, or unsupported information requiring follow-up or escalation. jobs.title: Quality Engineer II
jobs.description_text: At BioAgilytix, we are passionate about premier science and the impact it has on our world. Our team of highly experienced scientists and professionals deliver tailored services for supporting new medicine breakthroughs with best-in-class bioanalytical services. We are tirelessly committed to our customers by being solution-oriented and deadline-driven. . . and we are growing. Our culture is fast-paced, fun and never boring. Because we work across numerous clients and drug modalities, your career can develop rapidly. You’ll gain experience with a variety of challenges all while you enable life-changing, life-saving therapeutics to the patients who need them. The Quality Engineer II is responsible for providing quality assurance (QA) oversight of computer validations and equipment qualifications. He or she is responsible for maintaining a strong collaborative partnership with cross-functional team members that facilitates organizational success and meets business needs.

jobs.title: Scientist - ADA/PK
jobs.description_text: Scientist help turn well-executed laboratory work into dependable results for client studies. This role independently leads routine assay execution, applies sound technical judgment, reviews and interprets data, and works across laboratory operations, quality, and project teams to keep studies moving. You will work under general supervision, taking ownership of routine scientific activities while seeking guidance for novel or complex situations. The role offers the opportunity to contribute to study execution, scientific documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement in a collaborative laboratory environment. *Internal applications will be accepted until Monday, October 26th.

jobs.title: Scientist III - LC/MS (Bioanalytical)
jobs.description_text: In this hands-on, laboratory-based Scientist role, you will design, develop, and execute bioanalytical methods and experiments supporting the advancement of new therapies, with a particular focus on large-molecule LC/MS applications. You’ll spend much of your time at the bench performing method development, optimization, and GxP-compliant validation; generating and analyzing data; evaluating assay performance; and conducting targeted and untargeted analyses using liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys being in the lab, working through complex scientific problems, and seeing a method through from development to validation and execution. You’ll work across a variety of client programs and therapeutic areas, which means the science and day-to-day challenges can vary quite a bit. We’re looking for someone with strong LC/MS experience who is comfortable working in a regulated environment and understands the importance of producing accurate, high-quality data.

jobs.title: Care Manager, Michigan
jobs.description_text: The Care Manager will work with primary care practices as a part of the Provider Delivered Care Management Program (PDCMP). The Care Manager collaborates with the care team within each practice and leverages Aledade’s interdisciplinary care team to provide telephone-based health coaching, quality improvement, and care coordination. The Care Manager works closely with patients to support them in becoming active in their health care by better understanding their chronic conditions, helping them access care in the most appropriate setting, and improving quality of care. Care Managers utilize Aledade’s proprietary population health tool, the “Aledade App” to manage high-risk patients, using real-time data to identify and intervene on high utilizers who could benefit from more preventative and active management. Location Requirement: This is a remote role within Michigan. Candidates must be based in the state of Michigan to be considered. Salary Range: $70,000 to $87,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Clinical Outreach Specialist
jobs.description_text: As a Clinical Outreach Specialist, you will serve as a vital clinical bridge for high-risk patients, utilizing your clinical expertise to navigate the critical window between hospital discharge and home recovery. In this high-impact, telephonic role, you will perform complex medication reconciliations, identify looming clinical red flags, and proactively close care gaps to prevent unnecessary ER visits and readmissions. By blending empathetic patient education with data-driven population health tools, you will empower patients to manage their health effectively while collaborating directly with primary care practices to ensure no one falls through the cracks of the healthcare system. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones.

jobs.title: Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager (remote)
jobs.description_text: The Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager will assist in the development of an end to end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, to include creation of program guide and standard operating procedures. The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes. This Manager will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency. Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Executive Assistant (EA) serves as a strategic executive business partner supporting 3-4 assigned senior leadership members (SVPs+). Moving beyond traditional administrative support, the EA leverages organizational insight to optimize executive efficacy, proactively mitigate operational risks, and streamline cross-functional workflows. Operating in a fast-paced environment, this role acts as a trusted gatekeeper and operational liaison, ensuring leadership focus remains strictly aligned with company priorities.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, Minnesota
jobs.description_text: Executive Directors, Enterprise Partnerships are the business leads for large, strategic hospital and health system accounts. They act as a link between the field and Aledade Centralized support teams, focusing on ACO-specific business operations. Executive Directors partner with Medical Directors to align clinical initiatives with savings goals and provide the business case and direction for field team practice interactions. The Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, will be pivotal in building Aledade’s service model in the Minnesota market and beyond for a core group of strategic partners.

jobs.title: Michigan Payer Enrollment Operations Manager, Remote
jobs.description_text: Join a leadership team where your work directly shapes how Aledade’s physician practices succeed in value-based care. As Michigan Payer Enrollment Operations Manager (internally: Operations Manager, IPA), you’ll partner with IPA leadership to oversee the administrative engine behind our contracts, including payer contracts, contract membership, payment distribution, and client services delivery. You’ll collaborate across internal departments to help clients get the most out of pay-for-performance programs, risk sharing arrangements, and value-based contracts, and you’ll lead a team that may include an Operations Specialist and Membership Associates. Location Note: This is a remote role, with a strong preference for candidates based in Michigan due to the importance of understanding the state’s payer landscape and programs. Candidates located anywhere within the US will be considered. Salary Range: $90,000—$110,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: National Medical Director, Enterprise Partnerships, Remote
jobs.description_text: The National Medical Director leads and develops a team of Medical Directors and Clinical Directors responsible for clinical strategy across the Enterprise book of business. This role is accountable for the performance, growth, and coordination of that team — setting priorities, allocating clinical resources across portfolios, and ensuring consistent execution of Aledade's programs and technologies across ACOs. In addition to owning individual strategic market relationships directly, this leader builds the team's capability to develop and sustain relationships, influence clinical workflows, and drive value-based healthcare outcomes. This role requires demonstrated excellence in leading and coaching physician leaders, and in creating buy-in with internal and external stakeholders to promote and affect change in how healthcare is delivered.

jobs.title: Outreach Specialist, CACP
jobs.description_text: The CACP Outreach Specialist is the first step in the patient journey and supports the Comprehensive Advance Care Planning (CACP) program through high-volume inbound and outbound outreach. The role primarily manages outbound scheduling and inbound inquiries; educates patients about CACP; addresses reluctance with empathy and professionalism; and schedules facilitation appointments. The specialist follows approved scripts, workflows, SOPs, job aids, privacy requirements, and quality standards while balancing patient-centered service with daily performance expectations. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. The wage for this position is: $24.52 USD per hour. This range represents the expected base pay for the role across all U.S. locations, based on market data and internal benchmarking. Aledade offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes a company bonus, equity, 401k match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. A full review of our total rewards package will be discussed at the offer stage with the selected candidate.

jobs.title: Payer Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: The Payer Data Operations Analyst ensures data quality, accuracy, and reliability across payer data pipelines to support value-based contract performance. This role applies technical data skills and cross-functional leadership to resolve complex data issues, build proactive monitoring solutions, and partner with internal teams and payers to continuously enhance end-to-end data integrity.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Outreach Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description_text: As a Pharmacy Outreach Specialist, you'll be a vital link between patients, providers, and pharmacies, helping people stay on track with the medications that keep them healthy. In this role, you'll combine empathy, problem-solving, and clear communication to break down the real-world barriers that keep patients from taking their medications as prescribed, from cost concerns to simple forgetfulness. Your work directly improves patient health outcomes and contributes to pharmacy quality measures that matter across the healthcare system, all while building valuable skills in patient engagement, pharmacy operations, and healthcare communication.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) for our Florida practices and personally make an impact on patient care. Practice Transformation Specialists are HQ’s most direct interface with providers and can glean valuable insight into our partner practice’s happiness and needs. A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Please note: candidates must be based in Florida to be considered. Note on Travel: This is primarily a remote role, but on-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice. Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others. Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000 base + bonuses + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Implementation (Launch)
jobs.description_text: The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade's onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role structures, executes, and monitors assigned launch initiatives, establishing clear milestones and task structures aligned with overall program objectives to maintain project timelines. By leveraging data-driven governance and program discipline, the Program Manager ensures full transparency into launch progress and identifies potential roadblocks early. Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Combining strong organizational leadership with deep healthcare technology expertise, the ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments to advance Aledade's mission in value-based care.

jobs.title: Program Specialist, CMMI Programs
jobs.description_text: Reporting directly to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) Program Manager, the Program Specialist will be a pivotal contributor to the operational excellence and strategic growth of our CMMI initiatives. This role is responsible for the intricate management and refinement of core program processes, ensuring seamless execution across all facets of CMMI models (LEAD & REACH). The Specialist will play a key role in analyzing program performance, identifying opportunities for optimization, and collaborating with diverse internal teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance engagement and outcomes within the CMMI model framework. This position is central to translating strategic vision into operational reality, driving the continuous improvement and successful scaling of CMMI models. Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones. Salary Range: $80,000—$92,000 base + bonus + equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Execution Specialist, Remote

The RSES independently assesses priorities, establishes the regional operating cadence, and converts high-level objectives into weekly seller plans and field actions that increase physician engagement and accelerate growth. Operating as the connective leader across Sales, Field Marketing, Legal, Operations, and participating practices, the RSES designs and drives the execution model that enables sellers to spend more time building physician relationships. This role exercises sound judgment in prioritizing opportunities, identifying execution risks to the RSD and POD, improving processes, and determining the actions required to move prospects and deals forward. The RSES owns regional pipeline execution, high-impact roadshow and event strategy, deal readiness, contracting coordination, post-event conversion, and the performance insights needed to continuously improve regional results. The role serves as the primary regional liaison to Field Marketing and activates relationships with new signers and physician advocates to expand local momentum. Leveraging solid expertise in Salesforce development, integration patterns, data modeling, and system design, you will align platform capabilities with business objectives, optimize systems for performance and security, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and senior engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Counsel (Remote)
jobs.description_text: Aledade is seeking a Senior Counsel to join our Privacy Team, reporting to our Privacy Officer and Associate General Counsel. The ideal candidate will work independently to advise on privacy risk, own key privacy verticals end-to-end, and serve as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders on evolving privacy and AI regulatory issues. The successful candidate must bring strong legal judgment, confidence using AI tools to work efficiently, and enthusiasm for advising the business on emerging AI laws and governance frameworks. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer II - IAM
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Security Engineer II at Aledade, we play a central role in helping secure our enterprise, cloud native environments, and applications. We’re looking for security engineers that understand data and automation are important ingredients to our mission and know how to actively employ these ingredients at scale. Beyond the technical expertise, we value individuals who can partner cross-functionally across various teams, driving impactful outcomes and further securing our digital landscape. We prioritize Security-as-Code and API-first automation over manual administration, building resilient identity pipelines that scale seamlessly with our growth.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I - Data & Algorithm Engineering
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Software Engineer I at Aledade, we maintain, improve, and expand our data models and Databricks pipelines. We're looking for engineers who know that writing new code is not always the solution to a problem, but when technological changes are needed they create secure, maintainable, performant, correct, scalable, and stable solutions to the complex and unique challenges in our corner of the healthcare industry. The Patient Domain Team is responsible for turning complex health care data into well-defined insights about our patients that describes who they are and how they interact with the health care system. We are responsible for telling our partner practices more about who their patients are and how to ensure they receive the care they need. We are also responsible for figuring out how to monitor and observe our models in action to ensure they are driving impact across the company.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Risk
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Software Engineer II at Aledade, we maintain, improve, and expand our web application and data pipelines. We're looking for engineers who know that writing new code is not always the solution to a problem, but when technological changes are needed they create secure, maintainable, performant, correct, scalable, and stable solutions to the complex and unique challenges in our corner of the healthcare industry. They embrace strategies that minimize risk, leaning towards observability, alerting, metrics, high test coverage, and frequent releases that incrementally build value.

jobs.title: Sr. Health Plan Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: The Sr. Analyst, Health Plan Performance (HPP) Ops is responsible for extracting, analyzing, and transforming complex health plan data into actionable strategic insights. This role drives dashboard creation, leads rigorous quality assurance auditing, and provides cross-functional leadership and mentorship to optimize value-based care contract performance.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer- AI Platform
jobs.description_text: As a Staff Software Engineer on Aledade's AI Core Platform team, you will help build and operate the shared infrastructure that enables applications and AI agents across Aledade to securely and reliably access foundation models. You will work on the platform capabilities behind model access, including model gateways, cloud AI services, provider integrations, routing and fallback, usage controls, observability, reliability, and model governance. We’re looking for engineers who think beyond implementing individual features and consider the full lifecycle of production platform systems: architecture, scalability, failure modes, security, observability, operational readiness, cost, and developer experience. You will help evolve the platform as AI adoption grows across Aledade, building reusable and self-service capabilities rather than one-off solutions. You will work closely with engineers, product partners, security, infrastructure teams, and teams building AI applications and agents. Successful engineers in this role are comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, making pragmatic technical decisions, and building secure, maintainable, observable, and resilient systems.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Marketing Technology), Remote
jobs.description_text: As a Technical Product Manager you will be a key member of the team that designs solutions to support Aledade’s Growth (marketing and sales) team in their mission to enroll and engage new Aledade clients. The Technical Product Manager works alongside business owners, data analysts, and developers to define project goals, scope solutions, execute and roll out solutions. They are the interface between strategic business owners and development and ensure that Aledade creates a high-quality product with the ability to scale. In this role, you will lead product discovery, definition and execution for the platforms that drive Aledade's top-of-funnel marketing engine. You will work closely with our Growth partners and end users to uncover business needs, frame problems and opportunities, and turn them into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable success criteria. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll connect business strategy to technical delivery so that Aledade's martech investments produce high-quality, scalable products and measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Vice President,  Payer Engagement (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Vice President, Payer Engagement leads post-contract payer partnerships and executive health plan relationships to drive value-based care success and practice participation. In this high-visibility role, you'll serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior health plan executives, translating post-contract relationships into lasting, mutually beneficial success for practices, payers, and Aledade alike. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution—leading governance forums, shaping Medicare Advantage strategy, and rallying cross-functional teams around a shared vision for better outcomes. If you're energized by building high-trust executive relationships, driving measurable results in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment, and leading a team that thrives on collaboration and impact, this is your opportunity to shape what payer partnership looks like in value-based care. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office. Primary Duties:

VP, Enterprise Partnerships partner with Clinical and Medical Directors to align clinical initiatives with savings goals and provide the business case and direction for field team practice interactions. This role is the direct manager of an account management team responsible for client-facing interactions with our key external stakeholders, including health system management, financial leadership, and clinicians. jobs.description_text: The Analog & Power Electronics team is responsible for developing advanced power electronics for our space and military products. We are responsible for the entire development cycle from power architecture development to part selection, schematic and printed circuit board (PCB) design, verification testing, and production release. Interns in the Analog & Power team are typically responsible for design projects that directly contribute towards an on-going program or contribute towards advancing the Analog & Power Electronics team’s technology development road map. jobs.description_text: CONSTRUCTION SAFETY ENGINEER As part of a team of technicians and engineers, you will provide technical expertise and assist in the implementation of all Environmental, Health and Safety programs at the McGregor, TX rocket-engine test site. The ideal candidate is highly skilled in both environmental and occupational safety, is hands-on in a high-energy test environment, and can manage contractor and contingent-labor EHS with the same rigor as employee programs. We work as a highly integrated team and job responsibilities will include helping other programs to ensure the overall success of SpaceX. RESPONSIBILITIES: Work closely with test engineers, stand crews, and technician teams to perform detailed safety reviews of complex hazardous operations (hot fire, propellant loading, pressurization, ordnance, cryogenics, and post-test recovery) to ensure safe execution. Collaborate with department leadership to complete job hazard assessments and implement health and safety policies and procedures for Merlin, Raptor, fabrication, civil/construction, and support shops. jobs.title: Crane & Heavy Equipment Specialist (Starship)
jobs.description_text: CRANE AND HEAVY EQUIPMENT SPECIALIST (STARSHIP) The Crane and Heavy Equipment Specialist is a highly skilled and respected professional responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency of complex lifting and heavy equipment systems, including cranes, heavy lifting equipment, and related support systems. This role requires advanced technical expertise, leadership, and coordination across multiple teams to ensure mission-critical operations are executed flawlessly. The specialist is a proactive leader who drives safety, mentors team members, and implements innovative solutions to enhance team performance and system reliability. SpaceX doesn’t shut down production for maintenance, and instead, we find ways to predict failures and perform the maintenance without interrupting production. This role will require direct work with the engineers and technicians who design and build unique machines and perform risk analysis together to map out the maintenance strategy and find the best condition monitoring systems to monitor the performance. jobs.description_text: CRITICAL LIFT & TRANSPORT ENGINEER (STARSHIP) SpaceX is currently seeking an individual to join the launch site engineering team in Cape Canaveral, FL. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to utilize your multi-disciplinary knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop solutions to launch pad operations, ground support equipment, transportation, and production with the goal of maximizing efficiency without sacrificing safety or reliability. Specifically, you will be responsible for ensuring all aspects of critical transport and lift operations for our Starship and Super Heavy booster vehicles, as well as ground support equipment, have been properly designed, reviewed, and carried out. You will be responsible for addressing complex structural, civil, and mechanical issues that arise and utilizing engineering intuition as well as thorough calculation to provide engineering disposition for the path forward. RESPONSIBILITIES: Plan, analyze, and execute critical lifts and heavy-haul transports for large-scale hardware (e.g., rocket stages, ground support equipment, or structural components), ensuring compliance with safety standards, regulations (e.g., OSHA, ASME B30), and engineering best practices. jobs.description_text: DYNAMICS ENGINEER (FALCON & DRAGON) The Falcon and Dragon Dynamics team is responsible for all dynamic and vibration analyses on SpaceX’s operational vehicles. The Dynamics group owns all low and high-frequency loads, forcing function development, and vehicle response predictions, and ensures hardware is qualified for flight. The group is focused on supporting all variants of the fast-paced Falcon launch vehicle and America’s human spaceflight program, Dragon. The group has a wide range of responsibilities that include structural dynamics, flight data review and processing, model and analysis correlation, fairing and launch pad acoustics, engine dynamics, and software programming for tool development. Dynamics engineers are expected to have a strong intuition of dynamic systems and a broad range of engineering disciplines, in addition to having solid software and analytical skills. The satellite engineering team is hiring for satellite programs that are pushing the boundaries of in-space capabilities.
